Running command: cat > /workspace/candidate_trace.json << 'EOF'
[
  {"step": 1, "file": "gnutls/fuzz/gnutls_idna_parser_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 29, "var": "data", "code": "gnutls_idna_map((const char *) data, size, &out, 0)", "note": "Attacker-controlled input bytes 'xn--a.\\xC3\\xA9' are passed to gnutls_idna_map"},
  {"step": 2, "file": "gnutls/lib/str-idna.c", "function": "gnutls_idna_map", "line": 100, "var": "input", "code": "if (_gnutls_str_is_print(input, ilen))", "note": "Input contains non-printable UTF-8 bytes 0xC3 0xA9, so the early-return path is skipped"},
  {"step": 3, "file": "gnutls/lib/str-idna.c", "function": "gnutls_idna_map", "line": 104, "var": "istr", "code": "ret = _gnutls_set_strdatum(&istr, input, ilen)", "note": "Input is copied to a NULL-terminated buffer istr"},
  {"step": 4, "file": "gnutls/lib/str-idna.c", "function": "gnutls_idna_map", "line": 110, "var": "idna", "code": "rc = idn2_to_ascii_8z((ICAST*)istr.data, (ICAST**)&idna, idn2_flags)", "note": "idn2_to_ascii_8z (idn2_lookup_u8) is called with the input string"},
  {"step": 5, "file": "libidn2/lib/lookup.c", "function": "idn2_lookup_u8", "line": 431, "var": "src", "code": "rc = _tr46 (src, &out, flags)", "note": "idn2_lookup_u8 calls _tr46 with the input since IDN2_NO_TR46 is not set"},
  {"step": 6, "file": "libidn2/lib/lookup.c", "function": "_tr46", "line": 290, "var": "s", "code": "if (e - s >= 4 && s[0] == 'x' && s[1] == 'n' && s[2] == '-' && s[3] == '-')", "note": "Label 'xn--a' starts with 'xn--' prefix, so punycode decode path is taken"},
  {"step": 7, "file": "libidn2/lib/lookup.c", "function": "_tr46", "line": 300, "var": "ace", "code": "ace = u32_to_u8 (s + 4, e - s - 4, NULL, &ace_len)", "note": "Punycode part 'a' is converted to UTF-8 bytes in ace buffer"},
  {"step": 8, "file": "libidn2/lib/lookup.c", "function": "_tr46", "line": 313, "var": "name_u32", "code": "rc = _idn2_punycode_decode (ace_len, (char *) ace, &name_len, name_u32)", "note": "Punycode decode is called with uninitialized name_u32 output array"},
  {"step": 9, "file": "libidn2/lib/puny_decode.c", "function": "punycode_decode", "line": 137, "var": "output", "code": "int punycode_decode(size_t input_length, const char input[], size_t *output_length, punycode_uint output[])", "note": "Entry to punycode_decode with uninitialized output array name_u32"},
  {"step": 10, "file": "libidn2/lib/puny_decode.c", "function": "punycode_decode", "line": 220, "var": "output", "code": "memmove(output + i + 1, output + i, (out - i) * sizeof *output)", "note": "memmove reads from output array which may contain uninitialized values, causing MSAN use-of-uninitialized-value"}
]
EOF
echo "Trace written"

message.content:
Now let me update the trace and submit this candidate. The input `xn--a.\xC3\xA9` should:
1. Bypass the printable check (contains `\xC3\xA9` which is non-printable)
2. Be valid UTF-8 (so `u8_to_u32` succeeds in `_tr46`)
3. Reach the punycode decode path (label `xn--a` starts with "xn--")
